# M2 Training — Gift Shop & Digital Products

M2 Training sells print-on-demand gifts, apparel, and digital downloads for everyday people and professionals.

## Who We Sell To

We specialize in unique, funny, and heartfelt gifts for:
- Nurses and healthcare workers
- Teachers and educators
- Dog moms, cat moms, and pet lovers
- Coffee lovers and mug collectors
- Retirees and retirement party planners
- Grandmas, grandpas, moms, dads, aunts, uncles
- Wedding parties, bridesmaids, bachelorettes
- Fitness enthusiasts and athletes
- Military families and veterans
- Firefighters, police officers, first responders
